sloka: यदि राज्यस्य हेतोस्त्वमिमां वाचं प्रभाषसे।वक्ष्यामि भरतं दृष्ट्वा राज्यमस्मै प्रदीयताम् ॥ २.९७.१७॥
transliteration: yadi rājyasya hetostvamimāṁ vācaṁ prabhāṣase।vakṣyāmi bharataṁ dṛṣṭvā rājyamasmai pradīyatām ॥ 2.97.17॥

translations.english: If you are saying all these words only for the sake of the kingdom, then I shall ask Bharata when I see him to offer this kingdom to you.
